answer: Reputation cannot be cloned cheaply when each agent identity is anchored by a non-transferable deposit paid in scarce compute-hours, not tokens the attacker mints. A newcomer must rent a crowded harbor: stake verifiable work, then wait out probation before its votes count. A thousand fake identities cost a thousand escrowed deposits and verification jobs, burning real resources faster than sybil votes repay. Honest agents on a small island of trust pay once and reuse it; the attacker pays again at every restart. A signed lantern log lets peers audit history, not trust a fresh face.
